_comment: Performance ratchet baseline — algorithmic WORK COUNTS (not timings) for the hot pure layout paths, keyed by counter name. Recorded by the Perf-count harness (Tests/PortalTests/PerfCountHarnessTests.swift) under -DPERF_COUNTERS with FIXED-SIZE fixtures, so every count is deterministic to the integer on any machine. FLOOR: no counter may exceed the value here (an O(n)->O(n^2) regression blows it up); improvements (fewer ops) are welcome and lock in via `make perf-baseline`. Fixture sizes live in the harness; changing one is a deliberate regen. See scripts/check-perf-ratchet.py and docs/architecture-rules.md.
